column1: # BAL169-F22B (14 Oct 2026, account 4): glossed runs of the same Bouthillier office hand as 169 f.22r, read by this worker's eye at 2400 px
# (Baluze 169 c79 = f.37v, Bouthillier May 1639; c165 and c177 = the f.80 Memoire, Bouthillier July 1639). Not blind: I knew key.tsv.
# sign = numeral as written with the mark I see ('= separate rising acute stroke above, :=two dots, plain = no mark; a 1 always carries
# its own i-dot, which is not counted as a mark); letter signs as in earlier sections. unit = the gloss letters placed over that sign.
# Only signs I could place under the gloss are listed; '-' = sign present, unit not placeable. note: see NOTES "## BAL169-F22B".
